title: Ad Click-Through Rate Prediction

blueprintSignals.name: Ad-user embedding interaction
blueprintSignals.definition: dot product of ad and user embeddings
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Embedding versions must match between training and serving

blueprintSignals.name: Historical CTR with smoothing
blueprintSignals.definition: Bayesian-smoothed CTR by ad and placement
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Count only impressions before the scored one

blueprintSignals.name: Position at display
blueprintSignals.definition: slot number where the ad was shown, used in training and set to the top slot at serving
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Forgetting to neutralise it at serving time double-counts the position

blueprintSignals.name: Ad age and impression count
blueprintSignals.definition: hours since first impression and log of impressions so far
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Computed from impressions strictly before the scored one

label: For "Ad Click-Through Rate Prediction": Predict click probability for each ad candidate with calibrated outputs at millions of requests per second. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Position bias unmodelled so the model learns the old ranking.
